sheet.line: Sweet Potato Agnolotti: Candied Pecans, Brown Butter, Chèvre

facts.text: Agnolotti are a filled pasta of Piedmont in northwest Italy. Where ravioli are two pieces of pasta sealed around a filling, agnolotti are made from one piece folded over it; the small pinched kind is agnolotti del plin. The origin of the name is not settled (a cook of Montferrat in one legend, the Latin anellus in another).

Louisiana growers began calling their moist, orange sweet potatoes yams to set them apart from drier Eastern kinds; the LSU AgCenter dates the name to the 1930s and calls yam the trademark of the Louisiana sweet potato, though botanically a sweet potato and a true yam are not even in the same family. The Beauregard variety, released by the LSU AgCenter in 1987 and named for the Confederate general P. G. T. Beauregard, became an industry standard across the United States.
Chevre is the French word for goat, short for fromage de chevre; in English it means goat cheese, most often the fresh, soft, tangy kind. Said SHEV-ruh.
